# Release notes template

Every GitHub Release body must start with an English section, followed by a Chinese section.
Keep both sections in sync. Use the same headings and facts; do not publish Chinese-only notes.

```markdown
## English

### Highlights

- ...

### Fixes

- ...

### Upgrade notes

- ...

## 中文

### 重点

- ...

### 修复

- ...

### 升级说明

- ...
```

Rules:

- Feature and fix bullets must be factual and test-backed.
- If a metric is included, state the measurement environment and method.
- Do not include secrets, local paths, customer data, or private workspace names.
- Keep the English section first so GitHub visitors see it without expanding.
